parameters.name: XFRT
parameters.scientific_note: Fraction of assimilate partitioned to fruit. Range-constrained 0 <= XFRT <= 1.

parameters.name: XFINT
parameters.scientific_note: Initial dry matter partition to fruit (IPDMND risk constraint). Range-constrained 0 <= XFINT <= 0.5.

parameters.name: SFDUR
parameters.scientific_note: Seed fill duration. Also declared in phenology_temp module.

parameters.name: LNGSH
parameters.scientific_note: Long-shield/shelf fill duration; constrained LNGSH.init <= XMPAGE.init. Also declared in phenology_temp module.

parameters.name: XMAGE
parameters.scientific_note: Harvest age (max physiological age of fruit); constrained XMAGE.init <= XMPAGE.init. Also declared in phenology_temp module.

parameters.name: WTFSD
parameters.scientific_note: Maximum weight of a fruit component (shell/seed).

parameters.name: XMPAGE
parameters.scientific_note: Maximum physiological age of the fruit pool; upper anchor for LNGSH and XMAGE ordering constraints. Also declared in phenology_temp module.

parameters.name: FNSDT_OPT1
parameters.init_source: SPE fruit-growth FNSDT array, lower optimum anchor
parameters.scientific_note: Lower optimum anchor of FNSDT (fruit-set/development temperature response array).

parameters.name: FNSDT_OPT2
parameters.init_source: SPE fruit-growth FNSDT array, upper optimum anchor
parameters.scientific_note: Upper optimum anchor of FNSDT (fruit-set/development temperature response array).

parameters.name: WTPSD
parameters.scientific_note: Prefer measurement; not from yield calibration. Weight per seed.
